mod-alley-default-11.description: A straight, narrow alleyway paved with dark grey concrete or asphalt, bounded on two sides by parallel red brick walls with stone coping and vertical pilasters. On the left sits a single wooden shipping pallet next to scattered litter including crushed beverage cans, crumpled paper wrappers, and disposable cups. In the center is a stack of three brown cardboard boxes secured with straps, resting on a dark liquid puddle. Along the opposite wall near the boxes is a dark green commercial dumpster flanked by several black plastic garbage bags with orange ties, accompanied by another liquid spill. Toward the right on the north wall hangs a boxy wall-mounted air conditioner or ventilation unit with horizontal slats. At both ends along the southern wall, two blue 55-gallon drums clip partially through the brickwork. The alley has no end walls or ceiling and floats isolated over a misty grey grid with a lime-green light bar in the background void.
main_things: scattered litter (crushed cans and paper cups)
wrong: Two blue drums clip directly through the southern brick wall
The alley is an isolated corridor floating in an empty void/fog with a grid, lacking end walls, roof, or surrounding buildings
A bright yellow-green beam/strip floats detached in the void background
The front brick wall is as tall as the back wall, almost completely occluding the dumpster and trash bags in the front three-quarter view
Any labels or text on the trash, cans, boxes, dumpster, or AC unit are unreadable at this distance
